title: File:Patient with a massive parotid gland tumor.png
author: Osborneheadneck
description: Female diagnose with a rare massive salivary gland mixed tumor also known as pleomorphic adenoma. After parotidectomy, microscopic findings resulted in a salivary gland with mixed tumour (pleomorphic adenoma). Parotid tumor gross of 25cm x 27cm total parotidectomy specimen. Parotid tumor was removed completely by head and neck surgeon Dr. Ryan F. Osborne from a 71-year-old woman on 31 January 2012
